response.original_title: Deor De Viaah Vich Nach Lain De
response.overview: The story centers around a bustling Punjabi household where two spirited sisters-in-law (bharjaiyaan) are constantly at odds. They passionately compete to find what each believes is the "perfect bride" for their youngest brother-in-law (deor). However, their intense rivalry takes an unexpected turn when they discover that he is already secretly in love. The two sisters-in-law quickly form an alliance to break up his romance, leading to a chaotic mix of hilarious schemes, family drama, and emotional twists.
